message: Alibi morning brief. Use the alibi skill: read /status and /context (and memory/alibi.md). If last_night has a proposal, say whether it was kept. Then post one brief with kind morning and slot = slot_hint.morning from /context. Reply with the brief text.

Alibi checkpoint. Use the alibi skill: read /context and /digests. Post a brief (kind checkpoint, slot = slot_hint.checkpoint) only if a habit's status3 changed since the last digest or a planned block starts within 4 hours; otherwise reply NO_BRIEF.
Alibi night brief. Use the alibi skill: read /context. Append what slipped today to memory/alibi.md, then post one brief with kind night and slot = slot_hint.night. Reply with the brief text.
